::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 16 1900  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge XIV 3
:::

Dear [Lady Brandreth](people/person_208.qmd),
I hope in time to accomplish meeting you and conferring about the [G F S](organizations/other_23.qmd) affairs!

I have never had the specimen packet, not having been the Branch associate for Literature. I think [Miss Stanford](people/person_2209.qmd) has it for Winchester Country and [Miss Carey](people/person_2210.qmd) for the City

Yours sincerely 
C.M. Yonge
